description.value: Raven's Nest Resort is a family-run nature retreat nestled in BC's Columbia Valley on ʔAkisq̓nuk First Nation land, offering tent camping, van and RV sites, glamping domes, and log cabins. The campground opened in 2019 and has grown to include an 18-hole disc golf course, a shared bathroom building with flush toilets and showers, and scenic mountain surroundings near Fairmont Hot Springs. Touring cyclists will find a welcoming, pet-friendly base with fire rings, picnic tables, and easy access to the Columbia Valley's riding terrain.

address.value: Fairmont Hot Springs, British Columbia, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides detailed amenity information across multiple subpages. The camping page confirms flush toilets, hot showers (coin-operated), and dishwashing sinks in a shared building; bear safety policy specifies food must be stored in vehicles rather than dedicated bear lockers; reservations are accepted online. No mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, device charging, pump, tools, or camping fuel.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address derived from website footer ('Fairmont Hot Springs, British Columbia, Canada') — no street address available.
Seasonal operation only (May long weekend through last weekend in September); phone support limited to operating season.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating seasonal resort and campground near Fairmont Hot Springs with online booking, confirmed amenities, and an active website. Clearly useful to touring cyclists in the Columbia Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Resort is located on ʔAkisq̓nuk First Nation land (ɂamakɂis Ktunaxa). Showers are coin-operated. No Wi-Fi on property (explicitly stated on cabins page). Campground has 12 sites; not all can accommodate large trailers (max recommended 25 ft).

wow_evidence: family-run nature retreat nestled in BC's Columbia Valley on ʔAkisq̓nuk First Nation land, opened in 2019
